data.title: Prayers, anticipation await Pope Leo in Argentine care home
data.description: CLAYPOLE (ARGENTINA) - A home for disabled people on the outskirts of Buenos Aires was full of anticipation as it prepared to receive Pope Leo XIV, amid a growing controversy over state assistance for those with special needs in Argentina.

data.title: Ukraine, Russia see emergency alert systems hacked
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Emergency alert systems in Russia and Ukraine were hit in cyber attacks overnight leading into Monday, with fake warnings of possible nuclear strikes broadcast to users in both countries.

data.title: Belgian PM offers to quit over budget impasse
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever tendered his resignation to King Philippe on Monday over deadlocked budget talks, but the monarch deferred his decision until after a new meeting Friday.

data.title: Russia resumes strikes on Kherson after truce ends
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russia resumed strikes on the southern Ukrainian city of Kherson on Monday after the end of a local ceasefire in the area -- the longest truce in the war raging between the neighbours since 2022 -- Kyiv said.

data.title: Israel army withdraws after Hebron operation
data.description: HEBRON (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Israeli troops withdrew on Monday from an area of the occupied West Bank's largest city that they had evacuated of its Palestinian residents, following an attack that killed two soldiers in October.

data.title: ONE Championship: Tawanchai could return in April, Superlek may need nine more months
data.description: Tawanchai PK Saenchai could return to the ring around April 2027, while Superlek Kiatmoo9 may need another nine months to recover from knee surgery, according to ONE Championship boss Chatri Sityodtong.

data.title: Russia-Thai forum eyes $4.5bn
data.description: The second Russian-Thai Investment Forum in Bangkok attracted more than 2,000 participants and over 1,000 companies, representing investment potential of more than US$4.5 billion (152 billion baht).

data.title: Suvarnabhumi set to double passenger capacity
data.description: A new terminal and fourth runway could double Suvarnabhumi airport's annual passenger capacity to 120 million within the next seven years, according to Airports of Thailand's (AoT) fifth development plan for the airport.

data.title: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police protesting higher wages
data.description: ASHULIA — Thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers blocked a major highway and clashed with police on Monday, demanding a monthly minimum wage more than double their current pay, as protests spread across industrial hubs.

data.title: Nike drops chains with 'Jewelry Collection'
data.description: The world's largest sportswear brand is taking its iconic Swoosh beyond sneakers and apparel, venturing into the jewellery market with a new collection of demi-fine accessories for Holiday 2026.

data.title: Limited French school protests resume as holidays end
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - French students returning from autumn holidays blocked some high schools on Monday, determined to reinvigorate a protest movement despite government concessions during the break.

data.title: 'Special express' city bus trial gets mixed reviews
data.description: The trial run of new express bus services with limited stops was plagued by poor communication on Monday, with many Bangkok commuters left wondering why buses were passing them by without stopping.

data.title: Malaysia approves new train line extension to Thai border
data.description: The Malaysian government has approved an extension of its East Coast rail line to the Thai border in Narathiwat province .

data.title: 1,000-vehicle-protest to end at Govt House
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Monday he was not worried about a planned thousand-vehicle protest over economic hardship that will culminate near Government House later this week.

data.title: ALLY unveils Palm Hills, a 20-block walkable district in Bangkok’s Upper East Side
data.description: Starting with a shaded promenade and a 30-rai park, the privately funded plan aims to create one of Asia’s defining neighbourhoods

data.title: TIDLOR: A Decade of Financial Literacy for a Secure Future
data.description: For people working hard to make ends meet, access to a loan can provide much-needed breathing room. Building a more secure financial future, however, takes more than access to funding. It also takes the knowledge to make informed decisions and the confidence to put that knowledge into practice.

data.title: Huge search finds lost boy at Phetchabun waterfall
data.description: A seven-year-old boy spent more than eight hours wandering, lost in bamboo thickets in a ravine before being rescued, near Tat Yai Waterfall in Nam Nao district of Phetchaburi province.

data.title: PTTEP reports nine-month performance of 2026
data.description: Bangkok, 30 October 2026 – PTTEP announced its operating performance for the first nine months of 2026, highlighting continued progress in strengthening Thailand’s energy security through increased natural gas production and the development of domestic gas fields. Over the period, the company’s operations generated over 70,100 million baht in taxes and other revenues for the country, contributing to national development.

data.title: TIDLOR Receives Outstanding CEO, CFO, and IR at IAA Awards 2026 for 3rd Consecutive Year
data.description: Tidlor Holdings Public Company Limited, or Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , reinforces investment analyst confidence by receiving three awards at the IAA Awards for Listed Companies 2026: Outstanding CEO, Outstanding CFO , and Outstanding IR in the Finance and Securities category. Organized by the Investment Analysts Association (IAA), this marks the third consecutive year the company has received these recognitions.

data.title: Six Peruvian chefs from across Asia come together in Bangkok
data.description: Banyan Tree Bangkok and the Embassy of Peru will celebrate vibrant Peruvian culinary heritage with "Peru Mucho Gusto", held between Nov 11-15.

data.title: Building ASEAN’s Next Financial Corridor: Tokyo and Thailand Pioneer Digital Finance
data.description: Bridging institutional capital and tokenisation infrastructure to power regional growth as discussed at the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings 2026

data.title: Irish bookshops help meet UK demand for Sally Rooney novels
data.description: LONDONDERRY (UNITED KINGDOM) - Irish bookshops are helping readers in Britain and elsewhere obtain novels by Sally Rooney after her publisher halted UK supplies because of complications arising from the author's support for a pro-Palestinian group.

data.title: Malaysia Airlines says customers may be affected by Amadeus breach
data.description: Malaysia Airlines has said that some customer information may have been affected ‌by a cybersecurity incident involving Amadeus, its reservation-technology provider.

data.title: Police investigating spending by beauty queen’s foundation
data.description: The Central Investigation Bureau is investigating allegations of fraud involving the huge fund of donations managed by the Goodness Foundation of former beauty queen Panadda "Boom" Wongphudee.

data.title: Thousands of 'weight-loss' injector pens in passenger's bags
data.description: A Chinese passenger was caught with nearly 9,000 "weight-loss" injection pens, worth about 5.3 million baht, in his luggage on arrival at Suvarnabhumi airport from Bangladesh.

data.title: Horticultural expo debut falls short of visitor target
data.description: The International Horticultural Expo 2026 opened in Udon Thani on Sunday, but first-day attendance was below expectations and several problems emerged for urgent attention.

data.title: SX2026 brings together changemakers to turn crises into opportunities
data.description: In a world of constant change, the ability to adapt, prepare for challenges and embrace transformation is no longer optional but essential for survival. True sustainability extends beyond environmental protection to include people's ability to adapt to advances in technology, manage resources, and safeguard their health while embracing new opportunities.

data.title: SX2026 showcases global ideas for a sustainable future
data.description: From exploring the secrets of nature and discovering clean energy innovations to learning about disaster management technologies and sustainable urban development, Sustainability Expo 2026 (SX2026) offers visitors an opportunity to experience how countries around the world are turning sustainability ambitions into practical solutions.

data.title: Years after Islamic State's defeat, French jihadists face justice in Iraq
data.description: BAGHDAD - A decade ago, the Islamic State group broadcast its crimes as it recruited radicals from around the world and imposed a brutal system of oppression across swathes of Syria and Iraq.

data.title: Fire sweeps through houses in Bangkok community
data.description: A fire swept through 79 houses in Patthana Bon Kai community in Bangkok in the early hours of Monday. There there were no injuries reported.

data.title: Cathay Pacific says data from 53,000 bookings compromised in Amadeus cyberattack
data.description: Hong Kong flag carrier Cathay Pacific Airways has revealed that personal data and flight details of 53,000 bookings were compromised after hackers breached its technology service provider's system.

data.title: ONE Championship: Haggerty knee ruled legal in unanimous 12–0 review, source says
data.description: An independent review has unanimously ruled Jonathan Haggerty’s disputed knee against Hiroki Akimoto legal, the Bangkok Post understands, leaving his ONE Championship bantamweight kickboxing title victory intact.

data.title: Belief, business, Bangkok: What do people pray for?
data.description: Superstitions have always run deep in Thailand, from before the arrival of Buddhism to the modern age of technology. In Bangkok, interest in spirituality and fortune-seeking has become increasingly visible, with the practice popularly dubbed “mutelu”.

data.title: South Korea to double spending on AI and chips in 2027
data.description: SEOUL — South Korea will double spending on artificial intelligence (AI) and semiconductors in 2027 to a record high, the president said Monday, pledging to use the technology to turn the military into a "smart, elite force".

data.title: First point for Dragons, Port slump again
data.description: Ratchaburi claimed their first point of the AFC Champions League Elite on Tuesday night, holding Japan’s Kashiwa Reysol to a goalless draw, but Port slipped to a third straight defeat with a 3-0 loss at Johor Darul Ta’zim.

data.title: Big payday! Thailand’s heroes pocket Bt123m in rewards
data.description: Thailand’s Asian Para Games athletes enjoyed a big payday as they bagged over 123 million baht in cash rewards following their excellent performance at Aichi-Nagoya 2026 in Japan this month.
